subject: Junior Civil Construction Estimator, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Jr Civil Construction Estimator role advertised on SEEK. I'm based in Melton, so Melbourne is home ground, and estimating is where I want to build a career because it joins the drawings and the numbers.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026. The coursework included cost estimates and bills of quantities alongside road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater designs drawn in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, so reading drawings and specifications and turning them into quantities is familiar work. Before that I worked on site in the Philippines from April 2019 to February 2020, reviewing drawings, checking the work against them, tracking procurement and materials, and chasing pricing and deliveries with suppliers and subcontractors.

To be plain: I haven't worked in a paid estimating role yet, and I use Excel but haven't used Bluebeam or E1, so I'd be learning your tools and your rates from the junior end. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, and I'm available to travel for remote works.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

subject: Junior Estimator, Infrastructure Services SA, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Junior Estimator role with Infrastructure Services in Mile End, advertised on SEEK. The ad says you'd still like to hear from people who don't meet every criterion, so I'll be plain about where I stand.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026. The coursework included cost estimates and bills of quantities alongside road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater designs drawn in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads guides, so reviewing drawings and specifications and pricing quantities from them is familiar work. My civil construction experience is 11 months on site in the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020, reviewing drawings, doing inspections, tracking procurement and materials, and coordinating with suppliers and subcontractors.

I haven't worked in an estimating role or used Benchmark yet, and I use Word, Excel and PowerPoint. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Adelaide.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk with the Sales and Estimating Manager about the role.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
